faq.q: What is the cheapest hen party boat in Marbella?
faq.a: The Tier A boats – Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – start at €749 for 2 hours. For a full day (8 hours), it's €2,299, including skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT. Perfect for budget-conscious groups.

faq.q: How much does a Mangusta 80 cost for a hen party?
faq.a: The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) costs €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours. This includes a free jet ski, skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. Ideal for a luxury hen do with space to party.

faq.q: What is included in the boat rental price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs – just show up and celebrate.

faq.q: Can we bring our own decorations or DJ?
faq.a: Yes, most boats allow decorations and a DJ. We can arrange a DJ package or you can bring your own speaker. Just confirm with us when booking to ensure space and power availability.

faq.q: How far in advance should we book for a 2036 hen party?
faq.a: For peak season (June–September), book 3–4 months ahead. For off-peak, 4–6 weeks is usually fine. Early booking secures your preferred boat and time slot, especially for popular Tier A and Tier B options.

faq.q: What are the best departure points for a hen party boat?
faq.a: All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella. This puts you minutes from the Golden Mile, beach clubs, and nightlife. You can also arrange pick-up from Marbella Marina or Cabopino for an extra fee.

faq.q: Can we split the cost among the group?

data.body_html:
Planning a hen party in Marbella for 2036? A boat charter is the ultimate way to celebrate – sun, sea, and champagne with your closest friends. But how much does it actually cost? This budget breakdown covers our Tier A and Tier B boats, all-inclusive pricing, and tips to get the best value for your group. Whether you're after a 2-hour sunset cruise or a full-day party on a 24m Mangusta, we've got the numbers you need.

Why Choose a Boat for Your Hen Party?

Marbella's coastline offers 27 km of golden beaches, hidden coves like Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés, and iconic landmarks like La Concha mountain. A private boat lets you skip the crowded beach clubs and enjoy your own floating party. Departing from Puerto Banús, you're also steps from the Golden Mile's bars and restaurants. Plus, all our charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks – no hidden extras.

Hen Party Boat Budget Breakdown 2036

We offer two clear pricing tiers for hen parties. Tier A is the affordable option for groups of 9–11. Tier B is the luxury choice with a free jet ski. All prices include 21% Spanish VAT.

For other boats like the Azimut 58 Flybridge or Ferretti 94, pricing is available on request via WhatsApp. These are custom quotes based on your needs.

Inclusions: What You Get for Your Money

Every hen party charter includes: a licensed English-speaking skipper, fuel, bottled water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks (e.g., crisps, nuts), insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No surprises. You can also add catering, a DJ, or a photographer for an extra fee – just ask when booking.

How to Split the Cost Per Person

Hen parties often split the bill. Here's an example: an Azimut 39 (11 pax) for 8 hours at €2,299 works out to €209 per person. A Mangusta 80 (12 pax) for 4 hours at €4,719 is €393 each. For a budget-friendly option, the Astondoa 40 (9 pax) for 2 hours at €749 is just €83 per person. Use a group payment app to collect funds easily.

Best Boats for Different Hen Party Sizes

  • Small group (5–8 pax): Bandido (11.5m, 8 pax) or Red Tide (11m, 6 pax) – both depart Puerto Banús. Pricing on request.
  • Medium group (9–11 pax): Astondoa 40 (9 pax) or Azimut 39 (11 pax) – Tier A pricing from €749/2h.
  • Large group (12 pax): Mangusta 80 (24m) – Tier B from €4,719/4h. Also consider the Azimut 58 Flybridge or Ferretti 94 (pricing on request).

When to Book for 2036

Peak season in Marbella runs from June to September. For a hen party in these months, book 3–4 months in advance to secure your preferred boat and time slot. Off-peak (October–May) allows more flexibility – 4–6 weeks ahead is usually fine. Early birds often get better availability for the popular Tier A boats.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the cheapest hen party boat in Marbella?

The Tier A boats – Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – start at €749 for 2 hours. For a full day (8 hours), it's €2,299, including skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT. Perfect for budget-conscious groups.

How much does a Mangusta 80 cost for a hen party?

The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) costs €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours. This includes a free jet ski, skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. Ideal for a luxury hen do with space to party.

What is included in the boat rental price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs – just show up and celebrate.

Can we bring our own decorations or DJ?

Yes, most boats allow decorations and a DJ. We can arrange a DJ package or you can bring your own speaker. Just confirm with us when booking to ensure space and power availability.

How far in advance should we book for a 2036 hen party?

For peak season (June–September), book 3–4 months ahead. For off-peak, 4–6 weeks is usually fine. Early booking secures your preferred boat and time slot, especially for popular Tier A and Tier B options.

What are the best departure points for a hen party boat?

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella. This puts you minutes from the Golden Mile, beach clubs, and nightlife. You can also arrange pick-up from Marbella Marina or Cabopino for an extra fee.

Can we split the cost among the group?

Absolutely. With 11 guests on an Azimut 39, an 8-hour charter at €2,299 works out to just €209 per person. The Mangusta 80 for 12 people at €4,719 is €393 each. Easy to split via a group payment app.

What if the weather is bad on our hen party day?

We monitor forecasts closely. If conditions are unsafe, we reschedule or offer a full refund. For light rain, most boats have covered areas. Your skipper will advise on the day.

Ready to book your 2036 hen party boat? Check out our full [fleet and pricing](/blog/marbella-boat-rental-hen-party-budget-breakdown-2036/) or [contact us via WhatsApp](/blog/marbella-boat-rental-hen-party-budget-breakdown-2036/) for a custom quote. Cheers to the bride-to-be!
